item.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation fails to properly assign HTTP method attributes due to incorrect handling of the HTTP2Record's request method property. The tests fail with "AttributeError: can't set attribute 'method'" because the HTTP2RecordRequest class uses internal byte storage for method and the assignment pattern in the hook is incorrect.
item.contract: Modify the HTTP/2 hook implementation to correctly set the HTTP method on HTTP2Record instances by properly accessing the underlying request object's method property. The method should be set during record creation when the request is first initiated, using the appropriate HTTP method from the call arguments.
